A rater who set the weights (sets_weights=true; Julie only) is excluded by rule and their return is REFUSED by fit_pairs_analysis.py. A rater with knows_model_design=true (Sebastian) is eligible, and the analysis reports every verdict twice, with and without them; the excluding result governs. Letters A-D keep their round-1/round-2 meaning (rater_agreement.RATER_ROLES); new raters take E onward. E and F are reserved slots with no name: when Sebastian names a recruit, fill in name, set eligible=true, replace why_excluded with null, then build their page with build_fit_pages.py --rater <id>.
